rapport_notes: Friendly opening, good conversational tone, professional manner throughout; maintains warmth even when customer redirects.
process_discipline_notes: No differentiators repeated; silence held appropriately after open-ended questions.

top_strength: Rep nailed the quid pro quo framing upfront and anchored the estimate with a clear range personalized to the customer's minimal inventory (2.5–3.5 hours vs. the typical 3.5–5.5).
coaching_note: After the customer raised his concern about speed, cost, and thoroughness, the rep never dug deeper—ask 'what else' or 'tell me more' to uncover whether he was worried about damage, crew quality, or something else, then use that to land the differentiators (Meet Your Mover, On-Time Guarantee, Communication) he never mentioned; also omit rate-lock language in the close.
